text: Steiner described twelve ways of seeing the world, which he called world-views, and seven moods in which a soul can hold them. He linked the world-views with the twelve constellations of the zodiac and the moods with the seven planets. This window puts the pictures that the real sky shows at this birth into everyday words. Under each part, Show the working gives the original terms and where they come from.
These are pictures for reflection. Steiner himself warned that a person's inner constellation need not match the birth chart, so none of this is a statement about {who_obj}.

Willi Sucher used an old rule, the Hermetic Rule, to find a moment about nine months before birth, called the prenatal epoch. For this birth it falls on {date}, {days} days before birth. The rule says that the Moon then stood where the {target} is at birth.

Between the epoch and birth the Moon went round the zodiac about {n} times. Sucher read each round as a picture of one seven-year stretch of the coming life: the first round for ages 0 to 7, the second for 7 to 14, and so on.
